notes.title: v19.2 (9th June 2025)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7QVVFML.png[/img]

1) We have a new puzzle author and bug-finder-and-reporter, cl1694! They've already helped buff a post-game puzzle and opened a new world with new puzzles and buffs of other community puzzles. Check it out for a challenge! (I also got some great bug reports from Bleatnik.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rmlUULF.png[/img]

2) I'm trying yet another new idea for Chapter 0 to try to teach the concept of 'a robot going down and rewinding back up after doing something useful'. Meet Light? is out and Interference is in. It does use a one-off tile but I hope what the tile does and why I need it is self-evident enough. It'd be nice to scatter this new tile around the campaign some more but I haven't even begun to think about this yet. Anyway, let me know if this works or if it's completely off the mark, but I really want to get this game to work properly for all skill levels.

notes.title: 1st Releaseiversary: Chapter E out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kUSMgbn.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/r4kjabh.png[/img]

Entwined Time was released on itch.io 11th April 2024, after 13 months of development, and on Steam later that year. Ever since I got struck by divine inspiration while waiting at the bus stop I couldn't stop thinking about every little detail of this idea I wanted to explore and show to the world, and I've been so lucky to have attracted playtesters and post-release fans who have created their own puzzles and pushed the existing ones to their limits, helping refine the game into what it is today. That someone else cares about my ridiculous ideas as much as I do means the world to me. Thank you!

To celebrate one year of Entwining, we release Chapter E - Terraforming, all about tiles that destroy/hide other tiles. You'll learn more about Floorboards and discover Phaseboards, Glass Screws and Bombs. This is likely to not be the last post-game chapter that will be made. Enjoy!
